note: A GMSL2 deserializer board for the NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin Developer Kit (NVIDIA part P3762_A03) or Leopard's LI-AGO-CB carrier, through the 120-position J501 connector. "Supports up to 8 GMSL2 cameras" (gmsl_links 8) through two 4-position GMSL connectors J1_AA and J1_AB (ports 2), each broken out to four FAKRA cables by the supplied LI-FCB-4T1-SS-0.3M-NP-A0; deserializer "Maxim MAX96712" (the datasheet names one). Powered from an external 12 VDC supply (12 V 5 A adapter in the kit; a jumper selects a 9-15 VDC buck-boost input); its own power consumption is not stated. stated_mbps and lanes are null: the board's pages state neither the GMSL2 link rate nor the CSI-2 lanes to the Jetson; they are in Analog Devices' MAX96712 datasheet, whose page timed out when this entry was written (not entered from memory). Operating temperature "TBD"; size only in a drawing. mass_g is "~ 55 g (Without cable and power)".
interface: GMSL2 in (FAKRA via 4-in-1 cables); MIPI CSI-2 to the Jetson (J501)
